C0385.title: Chengdu Qingyang Police Dismantle Small-Loan Fraud Ring Preparing to Abscond with Funds
C0385.summary: In March 2026, Chengdu Qingyang police dismantled a criminal gang that defrauded over 30 victims of 2 million yuan under the guise of small loans. The group used staged lures and contract signing before planning to flee with the money. During the operation, police seized fraud scripts, contracts, and other evidence, and traced the case upstream to a telemarketing company.

references.title: Preparing to abscond with funds! Over 30 victims scammed out of 2 million yuan; Chengdu Qingyang police dismantle a "small loan"
